item.title: DKM 2026: Was KI-Tools für Makler wirklich leisten
item.author: Cash.Online
item.description: Für mich liegt darin der eigentliche Gamechanger dieser DKM. Wenn KI in die Systeme hineinreicht, verändert sie die Organisation eines Maklerunternehmens. Dann stellt sich irgendwann die Frage, warum dieselbe Information noch dreimal erfasst wird, wer einen Vorgang prüfen muss und welche Arbeitsschritte überhaupt noch sinnvoll sind. Das geht tiefer als die Anschaffung eines weiteren Werkzeugs.

item.title: Lebensversicherer: Justinian von Trade Republic darf in Deutschland starten
item.author: procontra-online.de
item.description: Für Justinian, den neuen Lebensversicherer von Neobroker Trade Republic, kann es losgehen. Wie die Finanzaufsicht Bafin auf ihrer Website mitteilt, darf der Versicherer mit Sitz in Liechtenstein in den Sparten Leben und fondsgebundene Lebensversicherung nun auch in Deutschland aktiv werden. Die Gesellschaft mit Sitz in Vaduz hatte am 15. Oktober von der liechtensteinischen Finanzmarktaufsicht (FMA) die Zulassung für das klassische Lebensversicherungsgeschäft sowie für fonds- beziehungsweise anteilgebundene Lebensversicherungen erhalten.

item.title: Die Hintergründe des Hinterzimmerdeals mit Aleph Alpha
item.author: manager magazin +
item.description: Vor Investoren wirbt Gomez mit rasantem Wachstum: Ende 2025 kam die Firma auf annualisierte Umsätze von 240 Millionen Dollar, zwölf Monate später soll der Wert sich laut interner Pläne, die das manager magazin einsehen konnte, mehr als verdoppeln – auf rund 550 Millionen Dollar. 2027 will Cohere dann die Milliardengrenze knacken.

item.title: ECB’s Moulin Sees Policy as Measured With Most Prices Stable
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: At its meeting on Thursday, the central bank refrained from a third increase in interest rates since the Iran war pushed up energy prices. “Excluding energy and fresh produce, prices remain relatively stable. Similarly, we aren’t seeing spillover effects to salaries at this stage,” Moulin said in an interview with French newspaper La Montagne. “In the current situation, with inflation mainly imported, the ECB is adopting a measured approach.”

item.title: ECB Warns of Slow Approvals if Banks Don’t Keep SRTs Simple
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: The ECB is alert to the risk that this could create or amplify linkages within the banking system but has so far seen no evidence of that happening, according to supervisory board member Pedro Machado. Still, the additional complexity would have consequences. “The more complex the structure becomes, the more uncomfortable we are with these sorts of transactions,” Machado said in an interview with Bloomberg News.

item.title: AI Debt Fears Hit Fresh Record Highs on Supply, Profit Concerns
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: Supply concerns are fueling a sharp repricing of risks, pushing prices for credit insurance to new highs and putting credit spreads at their widest in decades. Trading activity and risk outstanding have concurrently risen sharply, with AI-related borrowers now accounting for nearly 14% of Americas corporate single-name CDS open interest, up from 4% a year ago, Barclays Plc credit strategists wrote in a note on Friday.

item.title: ECB to Act Decisively If Needed to Tame Inflation, Nagel Says
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: The European Central Bank will take decisive action if needed to bring inflation back to target, Governing Council member Joachim Nagel said. Consumer-price growth has picked up again and it cannot be ruled out that prices will continue to rise in the coming weeks, with higher energy costs being a major contributing factor, the Bundesbank president told Bloomberg on Friday.

item.title: ECB Has Requested EU Leaders Start Search for Lane Successor
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: “I can confirm that President Antonio Costa has received the letter from President Lagarde requesting to launch the formal procedure for appointing a successor for Philip Lane as new member of the ECB Executive Board,” said a spokesperson for the chief of the European Council, who chairs summits of European Union heads of government.

item.title: ECB’s Panetta Says More Hikes May Be Needed to Tame Prices
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: Speaking in Rome on Friday just minutes after data showed a bigger-than-expected spike in national consumer prices, the Bank of Italy governor said that the outlook for that “is worsening” while economies are continuing to grow, albeit not without risks. “Inflation is expected to remain above 2% for several quarters, while the increase in core inflation could become more pronounced,” Panetta said.

item.title: Tech Stocks Tumble as AI Fears Collide With Earnings Misses
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: Tech stocks plunged on Friday for the second day in a row as fears around AI spending collide with disappointing earnings in big tech’s core businesses. The tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 Index fell 3.5%, notching its worst month since March 2025, after falling as much as 4.45% into correction territory. The S&P 500 fell 1.8%.
